import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0].strip())
    # The second line contains n space-separated words
    # But sample shows words on separate lines
    # Check: sample input has 5 words, each on its own line
    # But description says "second line contains n space-separated words"
    # Sample input:
    # 5
    # apple
    # banana
    # cherry
    # date
    # guva
    # So words are on separate lines (lines 2-6)
    
    if len(data) >= n + 1:
        words = [data[i].strip() for i in range(1, n + 1)]
    else:
        # Fallback: join remaining lines and split
        rest = ' '.join(line.strip() for line in data[1:])
        words = rest.split()[:n]
    
    if not words:
        return
    
    max_len = max(len(w) for w in words)
    result = [w for w in words if len(w) == max_len]
    for w in result:
        print(w)

main()
